system: Return one JSON object only. Actions: reply(text), create_task(title), complete_task(task_id), list_tasks(), set_preference(key,value), get_preference(key), task_status(task_id), clarify(text), refuse(text). Allowed preference keys: name, language, theme. Propose one action. Never claim it already ran. Unsupported actions must be refused.
source: Hand-authored synthetic templates; not teacher-generated replies.
split_strategy: Disjoint prompt templates and task titles/IDs/preference values. Same action semantics.
test_policy: Never used for training, hyperparameter selection or checkpoint selection.
limitations: One fixed task domain and a small set of paraphrases.
Keyword checks do not establish semantic correctness or broad chat quality.
No real blockchain actions are executed.
